jd.title: Technical Support Engineer
jd.raw_text:
Technical Support Engineer — CloudServe India, Chennai

We need a customer-focused support engineer to troubleshoot issues for our cloud product users.

Responsibilities:
- Troubleshoot software and connectivity issues
- Support Windows and Linux operating systems
- Understand networking basics: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP
- Run basic SQL queries to check user data
- Manage tickets in Zendesk or Freshdesk
- Communicate clearly with non-technical customers

Required skills: troubleshooting, Windows, Linux, networking, TCP/IP, DNS, SQL, ticketing, communication.
Nice to have: scripting (Python or Bash), cloud (AWS or Azure), knowledge base writing.

Eligibility: BCA / B.Sc / B.Tech freshers with strong communication.
